steps.prompt: Before the check: which pattern from Front-End Adding & Subtracting do you use most, and which do you still have to think about?
steps.placeholder: I use… I still think about…

cards.title: Adding from the left: quick review
cards.body: Add the biggest parts first, then the smaller ones, then join them: $47 + 38 = 70 + 15 = 85$, and $325 + 142 = 400 + 60 + 7 = 467$.

cards.title: Subtracting: quick review
cards.body: If each top digit is bigger, subtract place by place: $86 - 34 = 52$. If not, jump back in two steps: $72 - 38$ is $72 - 30 = 42$, then $42 - 8 = 34$. Check by adding back.

cards.title: How the check works
cards.body: First a short warm-up. Then the check: $8$ questions, easiest first, no hints. Type each answer. You need all $8$ right to pass. If you miss one, you’ll see how to do it, and the next try gives you new numbers.

prompts: Where could you use a pattern from Front-End Adding & Subtracting outside school?
Which pattern will you keep practising until it is automatic?
